posts.title: 【IELTS Task 1｜Multiple Diagrams】大學圖書館使用者滿意度
posts.excerpt: 圓餅圖＋表格的組合圖題（Multiple Diagrams）：大學圖書館的使用者類別與滿意度調查。
posts.body: 文章類型：**Multiple Diagrams（組合圖）**。一題裡有兩張以上的圖表，要分別描述，並在 overview 裡把兩張圖的重點一起帶出來。
posts.prompt:
> The chart and table below show the results of a survey of library users at a university. > > **Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.**

Library user satisfaction (%)

| | Very satisfied | Fairly satisfied | Not satisfied | |---|---|---|---| | Library opening hours | 65 | 35 | 0 | | Helpfulness of staff | 95 | 5 | 0 | | Availability of books | 50 | 40 | 10 | | Availability of journals | 45 | 35 | 20 | | Reliability of wi-fi | 48 | 33 | 19 | **題目要求** 1. 同時描述**圓餅圖**（使用者類別比例）與**表格**（五個項目的滿意度） 2. 寫出 **overview**，點出最重要的特徵並適當比較 3. 至少 150 字，建議 20 分鐘內完成
posts.sample:
The pie chart **gives information about** the types of users at a university library, **while** the table **shows** their levels of satisfaction with five different aspects of the library.

**Overall,** full-time undergraduates **account for the largest proportion of** survey respondents, **while** academic staff and distance-learning students **make up the smallest groups**. The survey results **also suggest that** library users are generally most satisfied with the helpfulness of staff.

**Among those who use the university library,** 44% are full-time undergraduates. Full-time postgraduates are **the second-largest group**, **accounting for one-fourth of** the respondents, **followed by** part-time postgraduates at 16%. Academic staff and distance-learning students are the smallest groups, accounting for 7% and 8%, **respectively**.

**As for** the five aspects of the library, helpfulness of staff and library opening hours are **the only two aspects that receive no negative feedback** from respondents, **with 95% being very satisfied with the former**. **Although** the other three aspects are **not rated as highly as** the first two, more users are still satisfied with them than dissatisfied. **About one-fifth of** respondents are dissatisfied with the availability of journals and the reliability of the Wi-Fi connection.
posts.structure:
| 段落 | 功能 | 內容重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 引言 | 改寫題目 | 說明圓餅圖和表格各自呈現什麼（*gives information about … while the table shows …*） |
| Overview | 最重要的特徵，不放細節數字 | ① 全職大學部學生最多、教職員與遠距學生最少 ② 對「員工協助」最滿意 |
| 主體一｜Pie chart | 由大到小依序描述 | 44% → 25% → 16% → 8% 與 7%，最後兩組合併說明 |
| 主體二｜Table | 先分組，再比較 | 零負評的兩項（開放時間、員工協助）／其餘三項滿意多於不滿意／約五分之一不滿期刊與 Wi-Fi |

**兩張圖分開描述**：一段寫圓餅圖、一段寫表格，overview 則把兩張圖的重點一起帶出來。表格沒有逐格念數字，而是**把相似的項目歸成一組**再比較。
posts.language:
**描述比例 Proportions**
- *X account(s) for the largest proportion of …*（X 占最大比例）
- *X make(s) up the smallest group(s).*（X 是最小的族群）
- *… the second-largest group, accounting for one-fourth of …*（第二大族群，占四分之一）
- *followed by X at 16%*（其次是 X，占 16%）
- *accounting for 7% and 8%, respectively*（分別占 7% 與 8%）

**比較與歸納 Comparisons**
- *the only two aspects that receive no negative feedback*（唯二沒有負評的項目）
- *with 95% being very satisfied with the former*（其中前者有 95% 非常滿意）
- *Although … are not rated as highly as …, more users are still satisfied with them than dissatisfied.*
- *About one-fifth of respondents are dissatisfied with …*（約五分之一的受訪者不滿意…）

**換句話說 Paraphrasing**
- *library users* → *respondents* / *those who use the university library*
- *25%* → *one-fourth*；*about 20%* → *about one-fifth*
- *0 not satisfied* → *receive no negative feedback*
posts.descriptors:
- **Task Achievement 任務達成**：有清楚的 overview，兩張圖的主要特徵都涵蓋；數據正確，並且有挑選重點、適當比較，而不是把所有數字列出來。
- **Coherence & Cohesion 連貫與銜接**：段落依「圓餅圖 → 表格」安排，以 *Overall*、*As for*、*Although*、*respectively*、*the former* 等銜接，讀者容易跟上。
- **Lexical Resource 詞彙**：比例的說法多樣（*account for*、*make up*、*one-fourth*、*one-fifth*），也替換了 *users / respondents*，避免重複。
- **Grammatical Range & Accuracy 文法**：分詞構句（*accounting for …*）、*with + 名詞 + V-ing*、*although* 讓步子句、比較句型 *not as highly as*，句型多樣且沒有明顯錯誤。

posts.title: 【IELTS Task 2｜Causes & Solutions】糧食短缺的原因與解決方法
posts.excerpt: 原因＋解法題型（Causes & Solutions）：為什麼世界上許多地方糧食不足？你會提出什麼解決方法？
posts.body: 文章類型：**Causes & Solutions（原因＋解法）**。這類題目會在同一題裡問兩個問題，兩個都要回答，才算完整回應題目。
posts.prompt:
> In many parts of the world, there is not enough food for everyone. **What do you think are the causes of this? What solutions can you suggest?**

**題目要求**

1. 說明造成糧食不足的**原因**（Causes）
2. 提出可行的**解決方法**（Solutions）
3. 至少 250 字，建議 40 分鐘內完成
posts.sample:
Nowadays, food shortages are becoming a crisis in some parts of the world. **There are several reasons why some regions face** [g]a shortage of food[/g]**, and I will suggest a couple of possible solutions.**

[g]Food shortages[/g] **are usually linked to** [r]conflict, political instability[/r] and [p]worsening weather conditions[/p]. **In recent years,** [r]wars[/r] in many countries have [g]disrupted agricultural production[/g] and [r]displaced large numbers of people[/r]. **When** refugees [r]are forced to move[/r] to neighbouring countries, the [r]sudden increase in population[/r] can also place additional pressure on [g]local food supplies[/g]. **Another major factor** is [p]increasingly extreme weather[/p]. [p]Higher temperatures, droughts[/p] and [p]insufficient rainfall[/p] can [g]damage crops[/g] and [g]reduce agricultural yields[/g], **making it difficult** for some regions to [g]maintain a sufficient food supply[/g].

**To address these problems, I believe that governments have a key role to play. Firstly,** areas [r]receiving large numbers of refugees[/r] should [g]be provided with sufficient food supplies[/g] and financial assistance **so that** the [r]needs of both refugees and local residents[/r] can be met. **Secondly, although** the [p]effects of climate change[/p] cannot be completely prevented, governments can use technology to [g]protect agricultural production[/g]. **For example,** they can invest in [p]developing drought- and heat-resistant crops[/p] through [g]genetic modification[/g] and adopt [g]controlled-environment agriculture[/g]. **Such farming systems** can provide [p]suitable temperatures, humidity levels[/p] and [p]lighting[/p] for crops, allowing them to grow even when [p]outdoor conditions[/p] are unfavourable.

**In conclusion, I believe** that wars and climate change are two **major contributors** to food shortages because they **disrupt agricultural production** and **damage farming conditions**, and **tackling these problems** requires **governments** to take effective action.
posts.legendText: 紅＝衝突與人口、紫＝氣候與天氣、綠＝糧食與農業；粗體＝句型與連接詞
posts.structure:
| 段落 | 功能 | 內容重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 引言 | 改寫題目＋點出全文方向 | 糧食短缺是部分地區的危機；接著會說明原因並提出解法 |
| 主體一｜Causes | 兩個原因，各自說明「如何」造成短缺 | ① 戰爭與政治不穩 → 農業中斷、難民湧入加重當地糧食壓力 ② 極端天氣 → 作物受損、產量下降 |
| 主體二｜Solutions | 兩個解法，和兩個原因一一對應 | ① 對應難民：提供糧食與經濟援助 ② 對應氣候：耐旱耐熱作物、可控環境農業 |
| 結論 | 重申立場、總結因果 | 戰爭與氣候變遷是主因，需要政府採取有效行動 |

這篇的關鍵是**原因和解法一一對應**：每個解法都在回應前面提到的某個原因，讀者可以很清楚地跟上邏輯。
posts.language:
**原因 Causes**
- *X is usually linked to A, B and C.*（X 通常與 A、B、C 有關）
- *Another major factor is …*（另一個主要因素是…）
- *… making it difficult for (sb) to (do sth)*（使某人難以…）
- *… place additional pressure on …*（對…造成額外壓力）

**解法 Solutions**
- *To address these problems, I believe that … have a key role to play.*
- *Firstly, … should be provided with … so that …*
- *Although … cannot be completely prevented, … can …*（讓步＋解法）
- *For example, they can invest in … and adopt …*

**主題字彙 Topic Vocabulary**
- [r]displace large numbers of people[/r]　使大量人口流離失所
- [g]disrupt agricultural production[/g]　中斷農業生產
- [g]reduce agricultural yields[/g]　降低農作物產量
- [p]drought- and heat-resistant crops[/p]　耐旱耐熱作物
- [g]controlled-environment agriculture[/g]　可控環境農業
posts.descriptors:
- **Task Response 任務回應**：兩個問題（原因、解法）都完整回答，立場清楚，每個論點都有延伸說明與例子。
- **Coherence & Cohesion 連貫與銜接**：段落分工明確；使用 *Another major factor*、*Firstly / Secondly*、*For example*、*In conclusion* 等連接語，且解法與原因互相呼應。
- **Lexical Resource 詞彙**：主題字彙精準（*agricultural yields*、*displaced*、*controlled-environment agriculture*），也有自然的搭配詞（*place pressure on*、*take effective action*），避免重複使用 *food shortage*。
- **Grammatical Range & Accuracy 文法**：混用複雜句型，包括 *when* 時間子句、*so that* 目的子句、*although* 讓步子句、分詞構句 *making it difficult…*、*allowing them to…*，以及被動語態 *be provided with*。
